# United Nations Development Programme
> UNDP works in 170+ countries and territories to end poverty, reduce inequalities, build resilience, and advance sustainable development.

UNDP publishes global policy guidance, country and regional programme information, research, data, stories, and thematic resources spanning climate, governance, crisis response, gender equality, digital transformation, and the Sustainable Development Goals.

## Core UNDP
- [Home](https://www.undp.org/): UNDP global homepage with access to programmes, priorities, stories, and country offices.
- [About Us](https://www.undp.org/about-us): Overview of UNDP’s mandate, mission, leadership, and global development role.
- [Our Leadership](https://www.undp.org/our-leadership): Profiles of UNDP senior leadership and executive management.
- [Executive Board](https://www.undp.org/executive-board): Information on the UNDP, UNFPA and UNOPS Executive Board and sessions.
- [Funding and Partners](https://www.undp.org/funding-and-partners): Overview of donor partnerships, financing, and collaboration models.
- [Careers](https://www.undp.org/careers): Jobs, recruitment information, and career opportunities across UNDP offices.
- [Contact Us](https://www.undp.org/contact-us): Contact information and ways to reach UNDP globally.

## Strategic Direction
- [Strategic Plan](https://www.undp.org/strategic-plan): UNDP’s corporate strategy, priorities, and development approach.
- [Future of Development](https://www.undp.org/future-development): Foresight and strategic thinking on emerging development challenges and opportunities.
- [Sustainable Development Goals](https://www.undp.org/sustainable-development-goals): UNDP’s work supporting SDG implementation and acceleration.
- [Human Development Reports](https://hdr.undp.org/): Global human development reports, indices, and analytical resources.
- [Annual Report](https://www.undp.org/annual-report): Corporate results, achievements, and institutional performance reporting.
- [Transparency](https://www.undp.org/transparency): Access to transparency, accountability, and organizational disclosure resources.

## Global Policy Areas
- [Poverty and Inequality](https://www.undp.org/poverty): Policy and programme work on poverty reduction and inequality.
- [Governance](https://www.undp.org/governance): Democratic governance, institutions, rule of law, and civic participation resources.
- [Crisis and Recovery](https://www.undp.org/crisis): Work on prevention, recovery, resilience, and crisis response.
- [Environment](https://www.undp.org/environment): Environmental sustainability, biodiversity, and nature-related development work.
- [Climate Change](https://www.undp.org/climate): Climate mitigation, adaptation, finance, and resilience initiatives.
- [Gender Equality](https://www.undp.org/gender-equality): Gender equality and women’s empowerment policy and programme resources.
- [HIV and Health](https://www.undp.org/hiv-and-health): Work on health, HIV, and development policy intersections.
- [Digital](https://www.undp.org/digital): Digital transformation, public digital infrastructure, and inclusive digital development.

## Flagship Initiatives and Thematic Platforms
- [UNDP Accelerator Labs](https://www.undp.org/acceleratorlabs): Global innovation network testing and scaling development solutions.
- [Sustainable Energy Hub](https://www.undp.org/energy): Energy access, clean energy transition, and sustainable energy policy support.
- [Nature, Climate and Energy](https://www.undp.org/nature-climate-and-energy): Integrated portfolio on climate, biodiversity, and energy transitions.
- [Timor-Leste and the SDGs?](https://www.undp.org/) : Placeholder removed in favor of verified links.
- [Digital Strategy](https://www.undp.org/digital): UNDP’s digital development priorities and transformation work.
- [Climate Promise](https://climatepromise.undp.org/): Support for countries strengthening national climate commitments and implementation.
- [Equator Initiative](https://www.equatorinitiative.org/): Community-led nature-based solutions and local sustainable development knowledge platform.
- [Seoul Policy Centre](https://www.undp.org/policy-centre/seoul): Knowledge-sharing hub focused on governance and development solutions.

## Research, Publications and Data
- [Publications](https://www.undp.org/publications): Reports, policy papers, guidance notes, and research publications.
- [Blog](https://www.undp.org/blog): Commentary and analysis on development issues from UNDP experts and partners.
- [Stories](https://www.undp.org/stories): Feature stories from UNDP programmes, countries, and thematic work.
- [Data Futures Platform](https://data.undp.org/): Data access and analytical resources supporting development insights.
- [Human Development Data Center](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center): Human development indicators, rankings, and downloadable datasets.
- [SDG Integration](https://www.undp.org/sdg-integration): Resources on integrated approaches to SDG implementation and policy coherence.

## Countries and Regions
- [Africa](https://www.undp.org/africa): Regional priorities, programmes, and stories from UNDP in Africa.
- [Arab States](https://www.undp.org/arab-states): Regional work across governance, resilience, climate, and development.
- [Asia and the Pacific](https://www.undp.org/asia-pacific): Regional initiatives, analysis, and country support in Asia-Pacific.
- [Europe and Central Asia](https://www.undp.org/europe-and-central-asia): Regional development work, policy support, and country programmes.
- [Latin America and the Caribbean](https://www.undp.org/latin-america): Regional priorities, publications, and programme updates.
- [Country Offices](https://www.undp.org/countries): Directory of UNDP country offices and local websites.
- [Geneva Representation Office](https://www.undp.org/geneva): UNDP representation and partnership engagement in Geneva.
- [Brussels Representation Office](https://www.undp.org/brussels): UNDP engagement with European institutions and partners in Brussels.

## Partnerships, Funding and Procurement
- [Funding Windows](https://www.undp.org/funding-windows): Thematic and pooled funding mechanisms supporting UNDP programmes.
- [Private Sector and Foundations](https://www.undp.org/private-sector-and-foundations): Collaboration models with businesses and philanthropic partners.
- [Procurement Notices](https://procurement-notices.undp.org/): Procurement opportunities, tenders, and vendor information.
- [UNDP Transparency Portal](https://open.undp.org/): Open data on projects, spending, results, and development activities.
- [Partners at a Glance](https://www.undp.org/funding-and-partners): Overview of UNDP’s funding and partnership ecosystem.

## News and Media
- [News Centre](https://www.undp.org/news-centre): Press releases, announcements, and institutional news updates.
- [Press Releases](https://www.undp.org/press-releases): Official UNDP press statements and media announcements.
- [Speeches](https://www.undp.org/speeches): Speeches and remarks by UNDP leadership.
- [Events](https://www.undp.org/events): Upcoming and past UNDP events, launches, and discussions.
- [Media Contacts](https://www.undp.org/media-contacts): Press contact information for journalists and media inquiries.

## Accountability and Governance
- [Evaluation](https://www.undp.org/evaluation): Evaluation policies, reports, and evidence on programme performance.
- [Audit and Investigations](https://www.undp.org/audit-and-investigations): Oversight, investigations, and internal audit resources.
- [Ethics](https://www.undp.org/ethics): Ethics office information, standards, and reporting channels.
- [Accountability](https://www.undp.org/accountability): Institutional accountability frameworks and governance information.
- [Transparency](https://www.undp.org/transparency): Public disclosure and transparency resources for UNDP operations.
